details:
I use a Unifi Dream Machine Pro router to block Russian and Chinese IPs since they constantly scan my ports for vulnerabilities. A few weeks ago I could no longer connect to VRChat, or more specifically I could launch the game and download a world, but then it would fade to black for a long time and the connection would time out. After much troubleshooting I can reliably reproduce the issue by only turning on and off that Russia IP ban.
This is weird to me because I am in the Northeastern US and can't even connect to my private instance on first log in. Sadly the Unifi event log does not work for me anymore so I can't see the block action. I know how to use Wireshark enough to perform a capture but I haven't been able to find the packets that are timing out to give you specific IPs. Could there be a BGP issue causing US traffic to be routed through Russia?
title: Can't connect to VRChat when blocking Russian IPs while in Eastern USA
